suporte.faq_meta_pergunta: How do I change my goal?
suporte.faq_meta_resposta: You can review your goal in the profile area. Use realistic values to track your work routine.
suporte.faq_dados_resposta: KORRE is designed as offline-first. The main data stay in the local database on your device.
suporte.faq_manutencao_resposta: Use the workshop area to track maintenance items, costs, and vehicle history.
suporte.faq_offline_pergunta: Can I use the app without internet?
suporte.faq_offline_resposta: Yes. Core flows for registration, income, expenses, and vehicles work with local data.
